results.title: How do you handle taxes as an Indie Hacker? (US) - Indie Hackers
results.snippet: Next, you'll have to worry about sales tax depending on your product (digital, physical, etc..). Before you have to worry about this you'll need substantial revenue to have nexus in each state (likely at least $100k in revenue in any 365 day period). I am not an accountant or lawyer so this has been a nightmare to figure out as all of the time I spent doing research was not time spent on my business. I hope some if this was helpful! ... For me as a solo indiehacker, a single member LLC is the best option: no double taxation of c-corp, much less paperwork/compliance/corporate governance busywork, income is reported directly on my taxes (because it is a "disregarded entity") which I do with TurboTax home & business.
